Five Essential Rules for Court-Ready Underpayment Calculations
Rule 1. Match Exact Financial Year (1 July)

Modern Award and National Minimum Wage rates change every 1 July. Never apply 2026 rates to 2024 or 2025 shifts. Duplicate Sheet 2 for each separate Financial Year (1 July to 30 June) using that year's official FWO Pay Guide PDF.
Rule 2. Never Compound Casual Rates & Check Award Sunday Tiers
Read Casual Column in FWO Pay Guide

Do NOT multiply the 25%-loaded casual rate ($33.85) by 1.50 for Saturday. Under Restaurant Award [MA000119] Level 2 (from 1 July 2026, base $27.08/hr): Casual Mon-Fri = $33.85 (125%), Sat = $40.62 (150%), Sun = $40.62 (150% for Intro-L2; whereas L3-L6 & Hospitality [MA000009] L2 pay 175% = $47.39), Public Holiday = $67.70 (250%).

Statutory Award rates are GROSS (pre-tax). If you were paid net into your bank without payslips, check myGov -> ATO Single Touch Payroll (STP) Income Statement to verify whether PAYG tax was reported or if payments were undeclared.

Each pay period stands on its own. Absent a valid contractual set-off clause, an employer generally cannot use a bonus or overpayment in one period to cancel out a statutory penalty shortfall in another period.

If your employer failed to keep time/wage records (s 535) or failed to issue compliant payslips within 1 working day (s 536), s 557C shifts the legal burden onto the employer to disprove your reasonable shift reconstruction.

Permanent (Full-Time / Part-Time) Accrued Annual Leave, Notice (s 117) & Redundancy (s 119) Calculator
NOTE: Casual employees generally do NOT accrue paid annual leave, notice of termination, or redundancy pay (leave inputs at 0 if casual).
Permanent Base Hourly Rate (Excl. Casual Loading)
Enter permanent FT/PT base rate (e.g. $27.08/hr; leave at $0.00 if Casual)
Total Ordinary Hours Worked During Employment
NES s 87 accrues 4 weeks (152h) per 1,976 ordinary hours = 0.076923h per ordinary hour
Paid Annual Leave Hours Already Taken
Deduct paid annual leave hours already taken during employment
Formula: MAX(0, Ordinary Hours * (152/1976) - Leave Hours Taken)
Under NES s 90(2), leave loading payable during employment must also be paid on termination
Gross Annual Leave Payout Received on Exit
Enter any gross unused annual leave amount already paid in final pay
Formula: MAX(0, Unused Hours * Base Rate * (1 + Loading%) - Paid on Exit)
38h for Full-Time, or agreed weekly hours for Part-Time employee
Unpaid Statutory Notice Weeks Owed (NES s 117)
<1yr: 1w | 1-3yrs: 2w | 3-5yrs: 3w | >5yrs: 4w (+1 extra week if >=45 yrs old & >=2 yrs service)
2. Payment in Lieu of Notice Shortfall (s 117)
Formula: Base Rate * Weekly Ordinary Hours * Unpaid Notice Weeks
Unpaid NES Redundancy Weeks Owed (NES s 119)
Applies only if employer has >=15 employees (non-small business genuine redundancy: 4 to 16 weeks)
Formula: Base Rate * Weekly Ordinary Hours * Unpaid Redundancy Weeks

Mandatory Evidence Checklist for Fair Work Underpayment & s 548 Small Claims
Search abr.business.gov.au to confirm the exact corporate employer (e.g. ABC Pty Ltd + ACN), NOT just the trading/shop sign name.
Written contract, letter of offer, Seek/Jora job ad screenshot, or onboarding text messages showing role and promised rate.
All Payslips OR Proof of Missing Payslips
Failure to issue compliant payslips within 1 working day breaches s 536 and triggers the s 557C reverse onus against the employer.
Deputy, Tanda, Employment Hero, Sling exports, WhatsApp/SMS group roster posts, or timestamped photos of paper rosters.
Export smartphone Google Maps Timeline showing daily arrival and departure times at the workplace (high weight when records are missing).
SMS/WhatsApp messages ('opening lockup', 'finished closing'), GoCard/public transport tap logs, or POS terminal receipts.
Full PDF bank statements highlighting every wage transfer; if paid cash-in-hand, contemporaneous diary notes or cash envelope photos.
Download ATO Single Touch Payroll statement to verify reported GROSS wages and whether PAYG tax withheld was actually remitted.
Download member contribution statement from your Super Fund (note: 12% SG & 7-business-day Payday Super apply from 1 July 2026).
Attach Sheet 2 & Sheet 3 PDF export to a formal email Letter of Demand giving the employer 7 to 14 days to rectify before filing Form 5.
